_comment: Threshold-distribution snapshots (ROADMAP brutal-review phase 4). One doc per (run_id, kind, layer) capturing the corpus-wide percentile distribution of a thresholded quantity. Consumed by miners that migrate hardcoded bands to percentile lookups (evidence_quality, ip_behavior_shift, campaign_convergence). Strict-dynamic: new metric kinds use the `kind` discriminator; they do not add new top-level fields.
